entries.reason: Weapon logic registration and firing resolution are gameplay systems with explicit logic ownership.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Registered weapon logic implementations and weapon-bearing subjects.
entries.view: Process-local logic registry plus caller-supplied weapon command context.
entries.read_set: Weapon definitions, cooldown/ammo state, targets and registered logic callbacks.
entries.write_set: Weapon state transitions and emitted WeaponEvent records after validation.
entries.structural_changes: No ECS structural mutation in registry operations; firing side effects are returned/emitted for caller-owned application.
entries.services: Registered IWeaponLogic observers are borrowed; registration replacement is synchronous.

entries.reason: The projectile logic consumes IProjectileService through cap::query and the script seam answers it through cap::provide, so the same capability appears on both faces; recording them makes the next provider or consumer declare itself instead of silently displacing the single-provider slot.
binds: eve.Weapon, eve.WeaponEntity, eve.WeaponMountEntity, eve.WeaponRigEntity, eve.AmmoPoolEntity; eve.provider.publishFor('IProjectileService', name, instance)
entries.thread_affinity: Weapon owner thread; the projectile service answers each spawn/step query synchronously with an owning value and retains nothing across frames

trim.absent_profile: Profiles without weapon drop the module and its projectile service; a script that published one keeps the handle but every later call reports the provider as gone

cost_notes: The projectile service is consulted once per projectile spawn/step; the seam marshals one table per call and retains no VM value.
